headline: Awarded contracts outnumbered tenders 55 to 34 this week
hook: Awarded contracts outnumbered tenders 55 to 34 in the last seven days. Today's picks: Zeevonk cable installation, Absheron FID and a Quebec lithium mine expansion.
board: Of 113 new projects in 55 countries, 55 were awarded and 34 went to tender; Energy led sectors with 72 and Europe led regions with 53.
question: Would you go after Zeevonk's 2029 cable campaign or the NAL lithium plant expansion first?

items.headline: Boskalis wins Zeevonk phase one inter-array cable contract
items.what: Boskalis has won what it calls a "sizeable" contract to transport and install inter-array cables for the first 1 GW phase of the 2 GW Zeevonk offshore wind project. In Boskalis' classification, sizeable means €50m to €150m.
items.who: Owner: Vattenfall and Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners JV. Installer: Boskalis. Cable supplier: TKF.
items.angle: An awarded installation scope with engineering starting soon. It matters to survey, cable protection system, seabed intervention and offshore support suppliers ahead of the 2029 campaign. A second 1 GW phase follows.
facts: Cables will ship from the Eemshaven factory on Boskalis' cable-laying vessel Boka Ocean.
The site lies 63-84 km off the Dutch coast near Bergen aan Zee (IJmuiden Ver Beta).
Phase two, due in 2032, adds 1 GW plus 500 MW of system integration, including an electrolyzer.
items.watch: Boskalis expects engineering to start shortly, ahead of the offshore installation campaign planned for 2029.

items.headline: TotalEnergies takes FID on Absheron full-field gas development
items.statLabel: Gas output target, plus 47,000 b/d condensate
items.what: African Mining Market reports that TotalEnergies and its partners confirmed FID on full-field development of the Absheron gas and condensate field. The field is in the Caspian Sea, about 100 km southeast of Baku. Start-up is expected in 2029.
items.who: Operator: TotalEnergies (35%). Partners: SOCAR (35%), XRG (30%). EPC: Not named in the report.
items.angle: FID moves a large offshore gas and condensate development into execution. It matters to EPC contractors, offshore fabricators and equipment suppliers, since execution packages come next. No contractors are named.
facts: The initial phase has produced since 2023: 1.5 bcm of gas and 12,000 b/d of condensate.
FID came the same day as TotalEnergies' Strategy and Outlook presentation.
CEO Patrick Pouyanné called Absheron a low cost, low emissions project.
items.watch: Contractor appointments for the full-field build, which the report does not name, ahead of the 2029 start-up.

items.headline: Elevra starts $366m North American Lithium mine expansion in Quebec
items.statLabel: Annual spodumene concentrate after expansion, vs 199,000 t
items.what: The Northern Miner reports that Elevra Lithium has started building a $366m (US$271m) three-stage brownfield expansion of its North American Lithium mine in Quebec. The expansion adds milling, flotation, filtration and crushing capacity.
items.who: Owner: Elevra Lithium. EPC: Not named in the report.
items.angle: A brownfield expansion now in execution. It matters to suppliers of milling, flotation, filtration, crushing and ore sorting equipment and to site contractors. Stages two and three run to mid-2028 and mid-2029.
facts: Stage one adds 15-20% to output from mid-2027. CEO Lucas Dow expects first extra tonnes in June.
Stage two lifts milling capacity to 6,500 tonnes per day in mid-2028.
The prefeasibility study shows a $943m post-tax NPV (8%), 50% IRR and 34-month payback.
items.watch: Elevra is negotiating another price-protected offtake, and stage one output is due from mid-2027.
